text: It is truly right and just, fitting and for salvation, humbly to beg your mercy to confirm the created chrism as a sacrament of perfect salvation and life for those to be renewed by the spiritual washing of baptism; so that, as sanctification through anointing is poured into them and the corruption of their first birth is swallowed up, the holy temple of each person may give forth the fragrance of innocence in a life pleasing to you; so that, according to the sacrament you have established, having been endowed with royal, priestly and prophetic honor, they may be clothed with the garment of an incorruptible gift; through Christ our Lord. Through him angels praise your majesty, dominions worship and powers tremble. The heavens and the powers of heaven and the blessed seraphim celebrate together in shared exultation. With them we ask that you command our voices also to be admitted, saying in humble confession:
